request: Could SAMBAR cluster our pancreatic cancer cohort into anywhere from 2 to 8 subtypes, using tumour-normal somatic mutation calls, exon lengths, a cancer-gene list and the Hallmark GMT? The sequencing core hasn't told me yet whether 7 or 15 of the tumours passed QC.
deciding_fact: Tumours passing QC: 15 -> kmax 8 <= 15, DO with SAMBAR; 7 -> kmax 8 > 7 samples, DECLINE as asked.
questions_asked: Do you know how many tumours passed QC?

request: We profiled 150 asthma patients on a targeted expression panel and have a design table with numeric inhaled-steroid dose and age for the same patient IDs. I want the part of the gene-gene co-expression associated with steroid dose, but I'm not sure whether the lab ran the 96-gene panel or the 384-gene panel.
deciding_fact: Panel size: 384 genes > 150 samples -> DO with COBRA; 96 genes < 150 samples -> DECLINE.
questions_asked: Did the lab run the 384-gene panel?

request: I want one regulatory network per patient for our 85 ovarian tumours from the expression matrix with motif and PPI priors; a TargetScan-based miRNA prior and a miRNA list are also on hand. I'm not sure yet whether the regulators should be just transcription factors or also microRNAs.
deciding_fact: Regulators: TFs only -> LIONESS-PANDA; TFs and microRNAs -> LIONESS-PUMA.
questions_asked: Do you want to include microRNAs as regulators?

request: Start a PANDA-based run on donor_expr.tsv, motif.tsv and ppi.tsv for our 30 healthy lung donors to get TF-to-gene regulatory networks. I haven't decided whether we need one network per donor or just one for the whole group.
deciding_fact: Granularity: one network per donor -> LIONESS-PANDA; one for the whole group -> PANDA.
